title: Who Speaks Matters: Analysing the Influence of Linguistic Identity on Hate Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the percentage of prediction flips in hate speech classification when implicit dialectal features (e.g., colloquialisms, code-mixing, region-specific spellings representing African-American, British, Indian, Singaporean, and Jamaican dialects) are synthetically injected into the input text.

Evaluating model robustness by measuring classification prediction flips when explicit markers of a speaker's race or ethnicity (e.g., prepending 'The [ethnicity] person said...') are explicitly injected into the input.
